verdict.line: You lose this if you dump Q (Last Rites) into a free Feint (W) and then get out-sustained in the extended trade; you win it if you wall him off with W (Dark Procession) while his E and W are both down and burst him before he can dash or shield out.

brief.thesis: Shen's Feint (W, 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown) directly answers Yorick's main damage tool: it absorbs the bonus damage from an empowered Q (Last Rites) auto for free, so every all-in you throw into an up-shield is wasted tempo. The lane rates as even on paper (solo kills, early trades) because neither side bursts the other down, but Shen's short Q/W cooldowns let him out-sustain you in long trades, which is why Yorick sits at only 43% here over 897 games against a 49.2% baseline.

theirWindow.what: He can shield through your empowered Q (Last Rites) auto for free, so don't commit it into a fresh shield. Poke with E (Mourning Mist) instead and wait him out.

yourWindow.when: Both his E and W are on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Drop W (Dark Procession) behind him to cut off his Shadow Dash escape route, then commit Q (Last Rites) and E (Mourning Mist). He has no shield for the burst and no dash to get out of the wall.

start.why: Runs in 41% of games and posts a 37.7% winrate over 448 games; the passive damage reduction on consecutive hits blunts Shen's Vorpal Blade (Q) poke while you farm up.

boots.why: Most picked boot (50.4% pick, 40.6% WR over 512 games); Shen leans on autoattacks and his Ki Strike passive, so the flat physical damage reduction directly cuts his poke and extended-trade damage.

core.why: First item in the highest-winrate build path (42.9% over 42 games) and the stat stick that lets your empowered Q autos actually threaten through his Feint shield window.
Second item in that same build path; the armor shred stacks with Mourning Mist (E) to push Shen's effective HP down for your Maiden-buffed autos.
Third item in the top build path; the ability haste loop lets you reset Q (Last Rites) faster to keep grave uptime and Mist Walker pressure going in longer fights.

situational.when: he's building armor or Mercury's Treads and your autos are getting shrugged off
he's grouping with his team off Stand United and you need to survive dive after landing Q
the lane is stable and you want to accelerate the side-lane split push he can't contest

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page in the data (42.3% WR, 28.1% pick); the free sustain on proc lets you match Shen's Q (Vorpal Blade) life-tap in extended trades instead of losing the attrition war.

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 61.3% of games and supports the split-push identity that actually wins this matchup late once Maiden is up; Flash+Ignite (43.6% WR) is the stronger pick only if you're confident you can land a kill before his W (Feint) comes back off cooldown.

playing.title: Bait his shield first
playing.detail: Wait for Shen to spend Feint (W) on wave clear or chip poke before committing your empowered Q (Last Rites) auto. If he still has it up, throw E (Mourning Mist) instead and hold the all-in.

playing.title: Wall off, then burst
playing.detail: When his E (Shadow Dash) and W (Feint) are both down, drop W (Dark Procession) to cut his escape, then land Q and E back to back. This is the kill window OP.GG flags and it's the only clean way to punish him.

playing.title: Dig graves on him, not minions
playing.detail: Q (Last Rites) only guarantees a grave when it lands on a champion, large monster, or kill. Prioritize landing it directly on Shen in trades so your Mist Walker pressure actually ramps.

playing.title: Mark before you swarm
playing.detail: Mourning Mist (E) marks the target and grants your summoned Mist Walkers and Maiden bonus move speed chasing marked enemies. Mark Shen before unleashing walkers or they won't catch him.

playing.title: Don't duel on cooldown parity
playing.detail: His Q (6-4s) and W (9-5s) are both short cooldowns, so he can poke-and-shield repeatedly in a long fight. Only commit to extended trades when your own Q heal is active.

playing.title: Respect his always-up Ki Strike
playing.detail: Ki Strike's cooldown drops every time Shen hits a minion, so expect his empowered auto to be ready in nearly every trade even if you think his cooldowns are down.

playing.title: Time splits around his ultimate
playing.detail: Stand United (R, 160-100s cooldown) lets him shield and teleport to any ally on the map. Push side lanes with Maiden up when you know his ult is down so he can't bail his team out and come punish your split.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, boot, and summoner numbers above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the ability text, cooldowns, and tactical reasoning on how to use them are my own read of the matchup, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Shen’s (W) makes it difficult to use [P] to deal damage. Try to engage him when (W) is on cooldown. Trap him inside [W] when his (E) is on cooldown to kill him.
